question: What was the launch year of ‘Pandit Deen Dayal Upadhyay Unnat Krishi Shiksha Yojana’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2016**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Pandit Deen Dayal Upadhyay Unnat Krishi Shiksha Yojana** was launched in 2016 by the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare.
 
• The scheme aims to promote **agriculture education and training** among rural youth.
 
• It focuses on improving agricultural productivity and sustainability through **skill development and knowledge dissemination.**
 
• The initiative is part of the government's efforts to transform agricultural practices and empower farmers with modern techniques.
 
• Key institutions such as agricultural universities and Krishi Vigyan Kendras (KVKs) play a pivotal role in implementing the scheme.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Krishi Vigyan Kendras (KVKs)**

 
 
• KVKs are agricultural extension centers established by the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR).
 
• They serve as the frontline institutions for the transfer of technology in agriculture and allied sectors.
 
• KVKs conduct skill development programs, on-farm trials, and demonstrations to enhance agricultural practices.
 
 
 
• **Agricultural Education in India**
 
 
• India has a network of agricultural universities and colleges focused on research, education, and extension services.
 
• These institutions aim to produce skilled professionals in the field of agriculture, horticulture, forestry, and allied sciences.
 
• Government schemes like the Unnat Krishi Shiksha Yojana strengthen these efforts by promoting practical knowledge and training.
 
 
 
• **Sustainable Agriculture**
 
 
• Sustainable agriculture refers to farming practices that meet current food needs without compromising future generations.
 
• It includes techniques like organic farming, crop rotation, and integrated pest management.
 
• Government schemes often promote sustainability to ensure long-term agricultural productivity.
 
 
 
• **Skill Development in Agriculture**
 
 
• Skill development initiatives aim to train farmers and rural youth in modern agricultural practices.
 
• Programs emphasize technology adoption, financial literacy, and entrepreneurship in agriculture.
 
• Such efforts contribute to improving livelihoods and boosting the rural economy.
